points: \item Architected and deployed a self-correcting RAG system using LangChain and Mistral 7B for financial literature review and quantitative research, improving answer reliability by ~20% and enabling AI-powered market analysis with vector database integration.

\item Engineered a hybrid retrieval workflow combining dense embeddings (FAISS) with BM25 search for financial data analysis, achieving 35% improvement in relevance for large-scale dataset processing and real-time trading signal generation.

\item Developed LLM-as-Judge evaluation framework to assess model bias, robustness, and performance across hundreds of financial QA examples, ensuring production-ready reliability and safeguards for algorithmic trading applications.

\item Optimized LLM inference through batched query extraction and transformer architectures, reducing API calls by ~80% and cutting inference costs by 60% while maintaining sub-second latency for real-time market data integration.

\item Designed ML-based anomaly detection system for trading workflows with risk identification and safeguards, reducing false signals by 25% while maintaining model robustness and ensuring appropriate bias mitigation in production environments.

\item Implemented a tool-using LLM agent (LangGraph/ReAct) with multi-channel frontends and integrated APIs for real-time financial data retrieval, enabling scalable AI-driven code generation and market opportunity identification for quant research.
